title: Synthesis, Structure, and Properties of a New Tetranuclear Terbium Hydroxotrifluoroacetate

synthesis.procedure: Tb(tfa)3(H2O)3 powder (1.45 g, 2.57 mmol) was dissolved with stirring in acetonitrile (20 mL) and heated to 80 °C. While stirring for 5 min, diethylenetriamine (deta, 560 μL, 5.18 mmol) was added dropwise. The solution was left in an open beaker in air for slow cooling and crystallization. After five days, a polycrystalline precipitate covered with a viscous gel-like fluid formed. The mother liquor was decanted, the precipitate was washed twice with acetonitrile and diethyl ether and kept in a closed vial for three months.
synthesis.temperature: 80 °C dissolution, then slow cooling in air
synthesis.time: 5 min addition; 5 days crystallization; 3 months storage in a closed vial
synthesis.vessel_or_method: open beaker in air; self-controlled hydrolysis / crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Mother liquor decanted; precipitate washed twice with acetonitrile and diethyl ether; kept in a closed vial for three months. Polycrystalline product.

properties.summary: Polycrystalline Tb4 shows metal-centered Tb3+ photoluminescence. Excitation includes a broad ligand-related band (maximum 370 nm) and Tb3+ f–f lines (maxima 489, 377, 368, 351, 341, 326, 318 nm). Under 365 nm excitation, 5D4→7FJ emission appears at 680, 668, 649, 622, 585, 545, and 490 nm, plus a broad ligand emission near 450 nm. 405 nm excitation gives weak Tb3+ emission (antenna effect); 489 nm direct excitation gives only Tb3+ 5D4→7FJ (J = 0–5) bands.
